title: Microplastic removal from wastewater through biopolymer and nanocellulose-based green technologies
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,79-117
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00634A, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sayam Sayam, Tarikul Islam, Tasnim Hanan Tusti, Joyjit Ghosh
This review explores nanocellulose and biopolymers as sustainable solutions for removing microplastics from wastewater, highlighting their efficiency, limitations, and the need for their integration with treatment systems and supportive regulations.
